hypothesis.title: Does High-Yield Credit Lead Equities? Relative Bond Performance and Next-Week Stock Returns
hypothesis.statement: Outperformance of high-yield bonds over Treasuries over five days predicts a higher SPY return over the next five days.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The slope of the next-5-day SPY return on the 5-day HYG-minus-IEF return is zero.
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: The slope is positive (HAC one-sided p < 0.05 and circular-shift placebo p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: Overlapping-horizon predictive regression with Newey-West HAC errors and circular-shift placebo
hypothesis.metric_name: slope of next-5d SPY return on 5d HYG-IEF return
